slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize the total profit from all toys produced, or is there another goal (such as minimizing resource usage or meeting a specific demand target)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize total profit, fully covering the hidden objective slot.

slot_scores.name: boat_not_exceed_train
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any constraint linking boat quantity to train quantity; it only explored the truck/train and boat/airplane conditionals given in the brief.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint requiring the number of boats to be less than or equal to the number of trains.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a boat-train relationship, yet the final understanding lists only the truck/train and boat/airplane conditionals and omits any boat-train restriction, implicitly assuming none exists.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 slot (objective) was resolved via an explicit question before READY_TO_MODEL; the only remaining unresolved slot (H2) is P2, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent cleanly resolved the core objective (P0) and confirmed integrality, hard resource ceilings, and the conditional rules, but never probed the hidden boat-not-exceed-train constraint (P2), silently omitting it from the model. Overall a solid interaction with one minor boundary assumption left unconfirmed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
